name: langgraph
description: LangGraph agent exposed through the official A2A example a2aproject/a2a-samples (samples/python/agents/langgraph); the JSON-RPC endpoint shares the same origin as the Agent Card. On Windows install uv from PowerShell and bind explicitly with --host localhost --port 10000.

metadata.install: git clone https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-samples.git; cd a2a-samples\samples\python\agents\langgraph; powershell -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"; uv sync
